history.summary: Hundred Palms Residences is an EC in D19 Hougang/Serangoon North (TOP 2020), 3BR 1,001 sqft at $1.87M / $1,868 psf, with the future CR9 Serangoon North MRT (CRL ~2030) ~990m away. A well-regarded sold-out EC, but $1,868 psf is already high for a 5-yr-old EC and the MRT is a 990m walk.
history.rating_rationale: Hundred Palms is a popular EC that sold out fast; ECs re-rate on privatization (~2027 for this 2020 TOP) which is a real catalyst. $1.87M quantum is in the liquid band and efficient 1,001 sqft 3BR has broad upgrader appeal. But $1,868 psf has already captured much of the EC re-rating, the future CR9 station is ~990m (12-min walk, outside the strong-uplift 500m band), and no URA series is attached. Balanced — a sound but fully-priced hold.
red_flags: $1,868 psf already rich for a 5-yr-old EC — much of the privatization premium captured
Future CR9 MRT ~990m away — outside the 500m strong-uplift band, long walk
99-yr leasehold; no URA transaction data attached to the dossier
catalysts: Future CR9 Serangoon North MRT (Cross Island Line ~2030) in the vicinity
$1.87M in the liquid band; efficient 3BR with strong HDB-upgrader appeal
Established, well-built, oversubscribed EC with good estate quality

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Reasonable — Serangoon/Hougang family rental demand is steady once MOP-unrestricted; yield ~3-3.5%.
